text: Constant pop-ups to sign in with Facebook (that I don't have) or spend money. Gameplay is so non-existent (just watch the reels spin then click a button to build villages with your winnings) I can feel my brain cells dying. Only signed up as part of another app's promotion so at least I can thank it for that but I wouldn't recommend this "game" to anyone.

I used to rate this game, however as it grows the technical issues affect your gameplay. Try speaking to support and it has become the worst customer service experience. Refusing to acknowledge technical issues and not compensating when it affects your progress in the game. I wouldn't spend any money in the game as you may be severely disappointed with the lack of support for paying players. Agent did not resolve the matter and did not even try!!

I will delete this game after realizing that its flaws heavily outweigh its benefits. No matter how much real money you spend, the game is programmed to always give you the absolute worst outcomes under the guise of 'luck.' Even when you pay a significant amount of money for features or passes, it is designed to ensure you never even reach a quarter of the actual rewards. This game is nothing but a money trap that drains your wallet without offering any fair return. Ultimately, everything is in

Stopped playing this game, every time you run out of spins you get numerous repetitive prompts to buy this buy that and buy the other. sick of it. and also. I invited loads of friends to play, they accepted etc and I never once got any of the rewards the game offers. friends have stopped playing because of the buy prompts. I know these games are out to make money, but cumon this is getting ridiculous. then you don't get much for your money. good bye coin master, or should I say con master.

just started playing and there are so many pop ups trying to get you to spend money. once you've ran out of spins it's pointless. you can't do anything other than buy more and they push it down your throat. I think it'll be getting uninstalled very soon!!!!!. id avoid personally Edit : The pop ups aren't about events. they are asking to purchase spins,cards,etc etc.

Can be fun when 1st starting out. But as you progress, the winnings/goals become more unachievable, even when you pay for more spins. It's ridiculous. In my last game, I needed 55000 to win. Even with 100000 and a boost from thors hammer, I couldn't get it. Also, more than once, winnings didn't come through when the game was having issues loading. Stay away if you don't want to sink yourself in a money pit.

great fun once you figure out what you are doing. edit after 2 months, still enjoy the game but find it difficult at times to progress. I feel like you need to spend cash to get anywhere which isn't great. I also feel the game purposely spins rubbish hand when you go high on the spins, and when you are close to a target it never let's you get to it before you run out of spins. It definitely draws you in, but It feels like an unfair game in all aspects.

The game has now become money orientated. The bonuses have now become unachievable unless you spend money. The reward is not worth the risk, unlocking card packs next to impossible when you can't level up as its trillions to build. Its kind of lost the spark the game used to have. Even events are now spend more to win more but next to impossible to complete again unless you're willing to spend money. I could actually spend money to win real cash rather than on a game, such a shame.

Con/Ad Master is an almost malware level ad spammer, with zero game play, designed to spam you with pop-ups and ads until you either buy something or quit. Run out of energy? No problem, just click through 8-9 ads. No game play, no skill, just an ad revenue generator that only they benefit from. Very aggressive monetisation and pay walls. Absolutely should be regulated and made illegal in the UK.

no ads in game though testerup but the pop ups are constant and infuriating! connecting to FB is antiquated and stupid - if I wanted to link my ACC I would have done so on arrival into the game. I count SIX. REPEATED. pop ups. what is the need for this? I should be able to say no and then that be the end of it. gameplay is dull. it's just a spin chance thing you spam until you have enough money to spam building the villages.

Re-writing my review in response to your reply. You said that the reason for all the pop-ups is so we don't miss out on any new events and offers. But why the hell do I have to be reminded EVERY TIME I run out of spins??? its ridiculous. Also, you don't need 7 different pop-ups for all these things that you want to remind us of. Just fit it into 1 pop-up. And only make the pop-up come up once when you open the app, not 7 - 10 different pop-ups every time you run out of spins

The game is really fun, but there are a few things that I don't like. First, I absolutely hate that when you raid or attack it takes you straight into your friends villages first. Second, the side quests/games are impossible to completely finish without spending real money, and lastly in order to get spins you need to spend money too. How about more spins for finishing the villages for example. spins run out way too fast.

Buying packs is expensive, and the game is addictive and predatory. The 'dance' and 'hunt' purchases are rigged. The free dance/hunt is always the worst prize, and I've paid for about a dozen second dances/hunts, and they're always the worst remaining prize on the first purchase. Every. Single. Time. If you have even a slight gambling problem, do not play this game.

I have been playing this game for years. The problem is just like with most of these games out nowadays, the longer you play the more you have to pay to continue in the game. Also the game is pretty much made to wear right before you hit a goal, you want to spends conveniently and you always have to purchase something unless you want to be at zero. Then there's no cheap packages conveniently, and then over 50% of the time even after you buy a package you still don't achieve that goal unless you

The amount of pop up prompts this game has for connecting with social media and real money purchases is obnoxious. When you run out of spins you get a minimum of 4 advertisement offers to pay for more energy, that's 3 advertisements to many. This last round I played I got 7 prompts in a row. Honestly, if it wasn't as easy as it is to earn mist play units by playing this game, I would uninstall it. Stop pushing people to pay money for this slot machine simulator and let them enjoy the game.

At first it's great game to pass time and help each other. The more I play, the more I feel like I want to uninstall: - so many pop-ups every time the multiplier doesn't much with the available spins (even if I have spins) - mandatory events (PvP or single player), I choose "let me rest", but it's not an actual choice you're giving to players - over priced, e.g."let me dance" for special events 4€. I understand it's how you make money, but there is no value for the the player and the gameplay

Expensive and addictive. I spent too much money, and some of the games glitch out, or are predetermined wins. Price goes up for everything after one purchase. I guess it's a good thing cus it makes you stop. One game glitched out my wins at and it wasn't counting them correctly so I couldn't win even though I was winning... Unless you like spending a ton of money, don't install

Still the same copy-paste format of casino-like games: slot machine as the base game, way too many deals to close every time you open the app and run out of spins, the costs (to expand your village) increasing much more than reward payouts as you continue, and with limited spins that doesn't accommodate! 5 spins every hour, and can only hold 50? Only play this if you're desperate, and even then I'd recommend others. Don't waste your time like I did, because it doesn't get better than the start.

I tried it for about a week. It was ok at first, I don’t have FB & I am not signing up to play dumb game. The popups are annoying all about FB. They want money for spins for the slot machine like a subscription, you need to keep refilling. Idk who these profiles were that were requesting invites to be friends. Bots? I only made it to level 12, Can't go forward without buying spins. I get attacked and money raided. Like a covert. Less landing on spins and shields. Like forcing you to pay up.

Update: The game is no longer fair and equitable for everyone. Moon Active has taken the joy out of the game with their worthless, inconsistent devaluation of many of their side games. For example, The most recent quest side game I got only had a grand prize of 12K spins. Most everyone else can choose up to a 65k spin side game. I contacted support last week because I had the same problem of not getting a token side game when others had. Your tips and tricks don't address your inequities.

Fun and engaging game play. There's always something to achieve. Build your area out, feed your pet (love this!), spin the wheel. Would like to see the pet enhancements & game play alot more. Perhaps the pet can have an area we can decorate, give them treats, train them for higher skill levels, have them run a maze, dress them (cool sunglasses or hats or armor), etc.. Lots of options there. The pet possibilities adds alot to this game that others don't have at all.

Well, there are a few things that frustrate me about the game, but other than those lil pesky details, I REALLY LOVEE THIS GAME!! It's def NOT a "relaxing" game, so if "laid back" is what you're looking for,this is NOT the one. CM is fast-paced with alot of moving parts. It's very exciting!! But for me, it's taken me a lil bit of playing for it to all make sense. I'm def still learning. Its a good workout on this ol'brain! Ya gotta be patient & find all the extras!😉 Happy Spinning! 🐷🎰🪙

Do not use guest mode. If something happens to your device and you lose game data, any purchases you made are not able to be replaced. Because I was lvl 90 and lost my data. I lost all my purchases and was told to re buy everything again. Unfortunately I would have to say stay away from Moon Active games, unless you use Facebook to back everything up. As a person with multiple degrees in IT, up to Doctorate's, I support software engineers, but not when it means stepping on the customer.

the ads are absolutely ridiculous! why when I go to click out of your ads it opens the game EVERY SINGLE TIME! I've played it... it got boring AF quickly. now the intrusive ads for the extremely boring game are really irritating... I wish I can block their ads but there are so many different ones it's insanity!!

genuinely don't think any game pmo as much as this one does. Every time you open the app, you have like 16 different pop-ups to close and of course, the same thing happens every. time. you run out of spins. Also, especially when it comes to the cards, the game is INCREDIBLY slow at loading. Other than that, the game is fine, the spin rate is about what you'd expect and as long as you're not actually spending money on it, and the gameplay is okay.

I've also played this game for years... you would think after a huge class action lawsuit that they would change many things in this game, but no. It gets more expensive and the whole entire game is rigged. They continue to add new challenges, but they're more expensive and you get less from them. Like the spark challenge and 👽 challenge... they are horrific as far as progression. The more you have, the more the game raises everything. It's honestly a huge addictive scam to prey off ppl.

I enjoy the game and it is really well made with great optics. As you get further, however, you need sooo many coins to build. The prizes for finishing a village should increase as well. 25 spins is useless. Also, WHO is paying $35 to extend the game by 5 minutes. If I ran a game like this, I would charge $0.99 for everything. I could see saying "It's just a dollar" and making a few purchases. But when they are charging $10, $20, $30 etc., I just laugh and ignore.

It is pretty fun to kill a few minutes, however it is hard to progress once you reach a certain point because you don't get a much energy or coins. I like that everything is fast paced so I'm not waiting for things. I did take a star away because the pop-ups are SO ANNOYING. Either let me opt out of them or stop showing them to me. I'm not gonna spend money on a mobile game.

This game is addictive, yes. However, the way this game is so money hungry is extremely annoying. The game has self promotional ads. They make advertisements for you to buy spins and coins whenever you run out of spins. However, they don't give you one pop up, they give you at least 5 different pop ups before they stop begging you for money. This is absolutely ridiculous. If you want to avoid spending your money, do not play this game. All the game does is beg for you to spend.

Do not purchase anything on this game! I purchased spins and other stuff to try to level up, it seems the more you purchase the less coins and such it gives you. Spun 6000+ spins and barely got 6b gold coins. There is no way to report problems and no one to contact for help. Spent over $50 on this trying to get to the next few villages but could not even level up one! Very very disappointed in this, would rather have the money I spent.

ok game, but the "purchase pop-ups" are absolutely ridiculous. EVERY SINGLE TIME you run low on spins, or attacks, or literally anything, a player is slammed with back to back 3/4/5 pop-ups to make a purchase, add Facebook contacts or share the game to get game credits. this is every single time you run low - it's absolutely unnecessary to do this so much.

Addictive game. Love the game, but crashes a lot with no support to get back lost spins, coins, or any other game issuses. updated.... still low rating. the higher you get, harder to build and move up. also they make it lot harder to get spins, attacks, and raids. went thru 120,000 spins at 1500 per spin and barely hit 3 of anything. plus way to many pop ups tiring to you to spend money.

An absolute incredible game. You get the feeling of Las Vegas slots with tons of extra quests to get involved with. You can advance in game very easily without spending your own money. Of course you can spend your own money if you choose to, but that that takes the fun of advancing using your own skills. The developers hit the nail on the head with Coin Master. It's just an incredibly well made game and super fun to play. You can also choose CM board game. Another well made game.

I've been playing for years. For the last year, if I buy or win things, they either don't show up,or, show up and disappear. I write, ss's, videos (which is ridiculous because i would have to run video every time I played) ...they swear they can't see problems. cleared memory, uninstall, reinstall... doesn't matter. Today I had just won 5k spins on top of what i had. I got busy on a call. Came back, and now!!!! It's 170 spins! So whatever issues..... they haven't fixed it

I have been playing this game for more than 4 years ,and have had several issues but today they are trying to rob me. They won't admit when they screw up, or there's a problem with the game i purchased a game pack , showed them i purchased it by sending a screenshot of my bank account, plus the receipt they emailed me and a screenshot showing that I didn't receive the product. But they absolutely refuse to fix it ???? I advise not purchasing anything from Coin Master!!!!

I liked playing it but once i reached high levels, rewards are so small. For example, I am currently in level 315 and I use 400 spins per spin and the cost to build is super high now and the chest rewards and other rewards are super small. some are just 40 or 80 spins not enough for a spin. I've spend so much money on buying spins or other things which is not worth it anymore. In my opinion, the higher level the higher rewards should be. I am ready to uninstall it.

Fun game, you can progress pretty far without spending any money, although you'll eventually stall out when the upgrades on your levels increase. Regardless, i still like it, and will continue to play it sparingly***** I'm editing my review due to a massive change through the early stage of the game. I made it to village 10, and im now stuck with minimal spins and no chance of progressing further without payment. On my first run, I made it much further than village 10, now it's impossible

Fun and cute but quickly plateaus. Constant ad pushing to Buy Buy Buy. Out of spins? Six or Seven popups Buy Buy Buy. You won some coins? Ha! Robbed and losing 2/3 before you can scroll down to spend them. Winning takes huge spin numbers to get enough to level past a stage - you win thousands, need billions to finish a single piece. Want to finish a map to get the big spin numbers needed? Check in every six hours to collect or you won't make it. Paying is very expensive for no gain.

I love CM but things are getting way out of hand at some of the cost...it keeps going up and my check doesn't will have to find another game to start it sucks 😔 would have given 100 stars but a lot of us out here just can't keep up with the demands to even stay in a team . It's not the tips and tricks. it's the cost. I've been playing coin master probably about a year and a half and it's just got where s the fun is taken out of it

Closing six pop-ups every time I spin has become too annoying. If you're not buying packages, it doesn't seem possible to ever reach the goal. It was fun at first, but I'm done. Bye. everytime you run out of spins, be prepared to close an annoying amount of offers. SEVEN offers in a row? if you buy anything, it worse.

I enjoy this game a lot. But, personally for me the target is too high .For example, if I am getting 30k spin, the target is 25k which is insane. But for other players(my friends )the target is mostly half the spins they are getting.Also recently I am not able to feed my pets as there is less opportunity given to collect pet's food. But for other players I have seen them watching ads and collecting food as much as they want.

its ok. the way it uses mechanisms to encourage spending of real money. you will get opportunities to almost win several types of mini games. and as soon as you get into the trap of spending a little, you will get thrown into a group with whales and you won't win unless you spend just huge $ daily. its a cash grab. don't give them your money.

I really like this game. Especially the side quests. Only thing I don't like is the cost of some of the barriers in the Tribal Quest game. They make it damn near impossible to gain the amount of "potion" it takes to pass the barrier. The level I'm on is asking over a million potions for the red flag. I'm just not purchasing any. That's insane!

I agree with Frank that the game doesn't always deliver what you've earned or bought, which is a big problem, especially if you made a purchase. I've contacted support, and they need screenshots of my last purchase (I guess they couldn't find it through the loyalty program... odd). I sent the screenshots yesterday, Wednesday, Jun 10, 2026, 5:12 PM Eastern Standard Time, and still haven't heard back.

LOVE THIS GAME! This is a fantastic game, with a ton of mini games and one of the main things I love, is all the mini games actually give rewards that can be used in the other games. It's not one of those one and done until you get more energy or points. So while yes you can buy within the game, obviously developers would appreciate, btw.. very affordable prices.. but you can play for hours without due to cross rewards. I am not usually one to play games, but I lose time playing this! LOVE!

pop ups the amount of pop ups that round Robin when you run out of energy is annoying. the game isn't even a game its more just advertisements on a slot machine that hunts for impatient people to pay to be on a leaderboard that means nothing. if you were to describe this to anyone it wouldn't sound fun. give me a pop up remover free of charge so that I don't get bombarded every time I run out or energy or accidently hit the spin. ill bump to 3 stars once that happens but game is subpar

I have been playing coin master for a very long time. I love it. I only have 2 things I wish they would address. It only goes up to level 21 so you don't get any units after that. And when you ask for spins from your teammates you get 2 spins. Really? I usually use at least 600 in a single spin. Can they up it to like 50 spins per request?

Starts out kind of fun, but you soon learn that without spending money, the game comes to an absolute crawl. There is zero strategy, just spin the wheel, get coins, use coins to build towns, maybe play a few side quests, also with no strategy. Everything involves getting coins and spins and energy to continue on, and the further you go, the more expensive building becomes, and the harder it becomes to get spins, without spending money. It's 100% random luck.

This game stinks, its always losing connection! Even when I have full bars. Can't do anything anymore! Before this started! Coin Master, we don't need to see 5 or more adds after running out of spins, every single time!!!!! We see it when getinto the game, when we run out of spins, even if its just a case of lowering the booster! if we didn't buy this and that the first 3x we've seen it. Chances are we are not going to purchase it the next 3, 4, 5, 150x we see it! Once is enough!

Too boring. It's so repetitive, and the further you advance through villages, it just takes longer to keep advancing. The further you go, the harder it is to make progress. There's zero reward for playing and beating levels, just a constant grind for no reason. Like Monopoly Go, there's literally no goals or prizes, no rewards to make gameplay better. Just steadily jack up prices the more you play.

I've been playing for a couple years great game but was very expensive to pay to play so I stopped paying money to play. Sometimes the game makes mistakes and doesn't give you what you earned. Lots of pop ups between each start up or in the middle of the game. They should break the pop ups up into 3 instead of 8 or 10 at one after another. The spins go fast and are hard to get lots of times you have to wait for spins to accumulate but still they go fast. They could give bigger gifts.

has lots of bugs, I tried multiple times to do my cards for chest and just keep giving the "something went wrong". if i let the game select my cards for me it will 'take' cards that I have very little of. instead of from the deck of cards that have over 200 of the same cards. but will take from the deck that only has 1. so I did it manually and it won't work. lots of time wasted. so much more problems i cant fit in here.

I used to love , love, love this game ! but the last 2 years when i had to mandatory updated the game started crashing . I try to play and it literally crashing within 5-15 sec. of opening it . it's beyond frustrating. I've been playing for the last 7 years and uve taken a fantastic game & ruined it because it's impossible to play without having it crash constantly. and continues to keep getting worse and worse with every update. I've uninstalled and reinstalled 5-10 in a row & still does it

very fun game except for the fact that they punish you for doing good in the game. like the more spins you have at the start of an event, they make it harder to progress to the next level. my wife and I were on the same level at the start of an event. I had 200k spins, and she had 75k. I had to get more soccer shoes then she did to progress. it's frustrating at times

every time I purchase something that gives one of many rewards, I always get the smallest possible reward which is not worth the purchase price. I was otherwise enjoying the game. always getting the smallest reward is really irritating. dont be greedy, that's how you lose out on future purchases. Also, i have to tell this game NO to purchases dozens of times per play session which is super annoying.

This game is horrible! It is fun, when you can play. But after playing for a few weeks, they've made their algorithm set up to take everything from you! No matter how careful nor how often you play. you wait all day for a few spins to play 3 minutes. you win noting. Then next day another 3 minutes. it's ugly! I hate it! I've played 2 months and am done!

The game needs more rewards upon village completion, without having to purchase anything. I have been playing this game for years now and I have spent money on it, but I am wheelchairbound, with minimal income and elderly. I would love to buy the items I need to advance quickly and have a high point score, but it's not happening. I need to eat and buy meds for my heart and legs... My wife hates it when I spend money on games, and never get back any. I guess I pick the wrong games to make cash...

Once you advance beyond approximately level 120, you only get about two minutes of gameplay before being required to make purchases. This isn't enjoyable. Each time you run out of spins, you encounter 24 or more pop-ups. It's quite frustrating. You spend all your time clicking on red X's just to close the in-game pop-ups.

I am a fan, I won't lie... but spending real money on this game is really frustrating when you don't get a lot of spins out of it. and for the past couple of days, I've spent trillions of coins on mystery magical chests and have not completed a set but manage to have 1000s of 1 card. also in the game shop, it costs $179.99 for 1.5b coins, and 1 of my magical chests cost 3.36b... it just doesn't make sense. the pricing for this game is really bad 👎

Genuine review, not a bot. I've been playing for yrs. I won't tell anyone to play because of the issues I have with lack of fairness. I've sent screen recordings. I was earning more for attacks until after reaching village 375 or so, then drastic drop. They won't look into it meanwhile I'm not earning what I should, thereby impacting advancing. Now they came up with a design that steals from you further by putting village items along the bottom instead of the top causing accidental placement.

Too many pop ups!! Not only do you get 7 pop ups after u run out of spins, but everytime you restart the game it gives more pop ups- they take up the entire sides of the app so much I can barely press the team badge or the bonus wheel.. if I want it I know where to find it- another thing, I've played this game for years this is like my 3rd account tho so I'm not sure what changed but I can't raid over 15x I could have 1500 spins and can only raid if the multiplier is 1-15x which isn't fair

My husband and I started this game 2 years ago as a stress reliever. The farther you get the more impossible it is to play most of the time I can't even log in it keeps kicking me out. I have lost so many rewards that I don't want to play anymore. Spending a lot of money on this game is the only way you can progress. It's not fun anymore.The company that made this game you should be ashamed, GREED is the problem,you got greedy making money that you have ruined what could have been a great game.

I enjoy this game very much but y'all need to let us Win sometime. This game is too expensive and don't get enough rewards and points. I agree with some others leaving reviews about the prices and losing interest in the game because you can't play long and don't have the money to keep playing when things get exciting. Please take this into consideration and reward us with free hours of play sometimes. You could offer a package where hours of play can be bought like Candy Crush.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely Addictive and So Much Fun! I love playing this game so much! It is the perfect mix of building, strategy, and a little bit of friendly rivalry. Spinning the wheel is incredibly satisfying, and there is nothing better than getting revenge on friends who attacked my village. The events are always fresh, the graphics are super cute, and it’s the perfect game to pick up and play!

I wish I could prevent those stupid boss challenges from automatically starting. I never choose to play them mainly because I don't want to play that long in one sitting. But they still continue to choose battles for me. I don't want to play with other people but when I return to the app it says I lost. So I lose points for something I don't choose in the first place. Major inconvenience.

Fantastic that the only ads are from CM--but they're notorious 😮‍💨! I love the multiple challenges each week, but wish the game play was a little more generous...I rarely complete 💯% of them . frustrating but intriguing enough to keep me trying. CM you really should cut back the pop-ups, it's especially annoying when you get more spins on your last spin and have to endure the pop-ups to get back to game play. all in all, this is my favorite...so keep up the good work 👍. 5 stars???

I love playing but the amount of pop-up deals to reload whatever you are out of when out of spins, tokens, etc is so annoying. It slows my phone up, causes the game to shut down, and seems unnecessary. I counted 5 of your deals that popped up when I didn't have any more spins. That's a lot and it's already listed and shown on the screen.

Extremely disappointed the gameplay has gotten worst even if you report the issues nothing is done. The game is literally designed to make you lose even if you got more than enough spins to get to the next reward. The only way to win rewards is to continuously make purchases. If you don't do that you won't get anything. I've been a long time player but now it's the gameplay is outright unattainable.

The game has glitches all the time. In order to receive any reward earned/purchased during a glitch, support will need you to prove it by supplying screenshots. Really? Players will need to take a screenshot after every spin, reward, purchase etc. JUUUST in case the game glitches. If not, support will tell you it didn't happen & you got everything. The worst part... if you write a poor review and/or dispute a purchase, because you did NOT get what you paid for, CM will deactivate your account.

when you first load the game every time it pushes you through every single pop up without exception and there's no way to stop pop ups m from appearing again so if you log in multiple times a day expect to spend 1-3 min just closing the pop ups. not to mention it does a similar thing when you dont have enough energy to spin again. its super annoying and makes me wanna quit, but I need to reach 330 for a quest so I keep playing 3 times a day.

this game stays interesting with a variety of daily missions for individuals, partners and teams. If your friends dont play... it's OK because there is no shortage of people who want to be friends with you because of the perks u can offer. of your friend are willing to play with you, better still. Regular gifts and the options to pay, it really has a lot to keep you playing. the only thing that bothers me is that sometimes no matter how hard you try, u just can't get going. try it for yourself.

I really enjoy playing Coin Master because it’s fun, relaxing, and addictive at the same time. I like spinning the wheel, raiding villages, and collecting cards during events. The graphics are colorful and the game is easy to play, which makes it perfect for passing time. Sometimes it gets frustrating when spins run out quickly, but overall it’s still one of my favorite mobile games.

standards are set WAY TO HIGH FOR THIS GAME. It's a rip off game. then ads keep popping up buy this buy that. I'll be moving on to new game. only thing I can say is support is good AT TIMES I REPEAT AT TIMES OR WON'T ANSWER AT ALL. price for packages are way to high, then when you do buy one it goes even up more, then game always looses connection. so if you do not get your package you bought good luck getting ahold of support. ( Pretty much most of times will not answer)

If Icould give the app a zero I would. You learn a little about spins, program is AGAINST you trying to advance in anything. I know enough to play, but I'm far from stupid, too. You will see how it is programmed against you & you simply don't earn ANYTHING in the app. I think I'd rather play games where I can at least earn money or points towards gift cards. It would be time wisely spent. Truly a fun game, but 10x more frustrating when you learn how to play. NOT WORTH IT IN THE LONG RUN.

I very much dislike the current form of the game. The past form where you gain currency to move forward in villages was a more tangible experience of your progress. The goofy little tabs on the current form gives a lesser form of knowing your progress and the satisfaction in your progress. a great little app to Kill time when you have, a lot more time, then you know what to do with!!! coin master is the answer... a great little game , with killer graphics and it's really easy to understand... yhe pay outs could. be a little better, to keep players, in the game and not focused on how to get more coin to play the game.. but all in all .. its a definite time killer.. when you want to do more then just sitting around scratching your ass!!

Oh! you're out of spins? Here are 16 pop ups to remind you that you JUST used your last spin. This is by far, the most irritating part of the game. Yes i'm out of spins. Now I have not played a great many of these type of games, but I absolutely love and am addicted to Coin Master. Unfortunately for them, I have yet to spend even one dime. WAY too many pop-ups. Seriously. Game would be more fun if there were some way to time gate at least some of them (maybe the seasonal ones?). Other people complained about the lack of spins you get but I kept winning 100, 200, or even 300 spins so never had that problem. No technical issues, just no real fun to be had.

I have been playing Coin Master for years. I appreciate it was made easier to progress to higher villages. It was nearly impossible before. Negative experience. Most 5 star reviews for this game even have a negative comment to make. The game is rigged. This is one of the worst games I have ever played. It is pointless. There is no content. Spin the wheel build the base repeat. I love this game, very addictive. It's basically a slot machine. While you get to "build" a village, you have no agency as a player, and no benefit based on what you built. pretty cool, I lost a previous account that was as old when the game first game out and all the upgrades and updates to everything make this game so much better and tricky. awesome job creators. Definitely one of the best games I've played for being a grown man.

Downloaded for credit in another game, but it's a lot more fun than I expected! I will keep playing! I still like the game, but am disappointed that the only way to feed your pet is to buy food. Maybe silly, but bothers me a lot. :(

It's a pay to play. I wouldn't recommend. The only reason why I'd continue to play is because I set a goal to reach Romania. (I'm learning Romanian so I just thought it would be cool to hit it.) But to even get enough money to advanced you'll need to pay. Maybe if you want to get rid of bad reviews at least cut the time to wait for a spin refill or at least get rid of the 50/50 max. Make it so it can at least build up or have a higher max spins.

As ive played I have found that they are quite greedy. If you make a purchase they make sure to make the game harder instead of it getting easier. Although I understand the need to knock the spins down to nothing, it then means you're screwed for the rest of the events where you are completely unable to progress. New ones come, but you still can't get far. Greedy af. And if you're missing rewards, dont worry, they'll tell you everything is fine but you still dont get your missing 81k spins.

The game is fun, but it gets frustrating. The chests become useless after certain levels because they're all repeat cards. The chests are also expensive as you level up, too expensive to receive THE SAME CARDS YOU ALREADY HAVE! If you complete a collection, why still get cards from it? The village news and the revenge list aren't even on the same page. Players are popping up on my list who haven't attacked ir raided me in days. BUT, like I said, it's a fun game. 👍

Now for the addition to my review. I once absolutely loved this game. However, as of lately the game seems to make it impossible to complete anything. It seems the longer one plays this game, even spending real $, that they just make it impossible to complete anything. Usually I would expect more for my loyalty not less. I have deleted the game and will no longer play it. I feel like I was not appreciated as a customer. Although I will miss parts of the game, I will not miss your abuse.

Prices are high for the extra stuff, especially when you have to pay the extra to have it be converted to your currency. And for the amount you pay you should get more stuff. But other than that, it's a very addictive game. Wish you had a longer time limit for some of the mini games, especially for the bonus missions/rewards, cause when the timer runs out, you can't complete some of the other tasks/mini rewards. Also, the mini games for your teams should have more time, too.

This is a fun game to compete with. However, all the pop ups when you run low or out of spins is ridiculous. You don't need to pop so much up on the game while players are playing. Once is enough at the start of the game. Not while I'm playing. It blocks you from receiving rewards. If you want people to spend money, atleast allow them to play without being blocked by the 6 different deals your offering while they are playing.

Bought all 4 Packages of the Mystery Offer, had over 4000 spins. Fell asleep woke up all spins gone. I was not playing. Not activity and spins gone. $35 dollars all gone. I saved extra all week to get to buy those. It was my treat to myself. Just gone. The pop ups are too much. I swear they time your attacks and raids so you either have to buy or lose it all. I use to love this game. Will not be playing anymore.

The game is fun, but it's a scam. The dance for 99 cents always lands on the least amount prize. Never fails. Every time you dance for money, it always lands in the lowest prize, and the amount goes up every time you dance. The golden pass when you buy it, its mission for prizes is ridiculous. It's a waste of money if you can't complete the missions. The flavor frenzie album set when you complete the set, you also have to get 3 new emoji, and that's not easy. Everyone is so greedy.

pretty upset that I was screwed put of spins today. won them in the attack event, 300 spins, and after one spin of x3, and went down to 1 spin left. this isn't the first glitch I've had like this, but the glitches all the time aren't the only problem. if you have an issue, there is no where to go in the support section to put in a help ticket or file a discrepancy for an issue to be handled. I've spent real money on the game, so I'm disappointed that this keeps happening and am likely quitting.

I really enjoy playing this game! I was close to Village 210, but unfortunately, I somehow deleted the app, and all my progress was lost. Since I don’t have Facebook to save my progress, there was no way to recover it. It would be great if there were an option to log in with an email account so players don’t lose everything if something like this happens. Hope the developers consider adding this feature!

Between my wife and I we bought 3 packs for the pet food and pet experience. We didn't get either and then both wrote to the customer support. They gave us the food but not the experience. Also there has been twice that I didn't get my 150 spins from a reward (also didn't get my 40 million coins the second time). I wrote customer support and they said that they would get back to me. First one was 2 months ago and the second a week ago. I still haven't received a response.

While the game started as overall fun. it now feels like work. Villages are so expensive to build and you can never get the gold cards to complete sets!!!! I've spent billions on chests only to get the same sickening cards over and over. It's so frustrating now and it doesnt feel like a game anymore. Not to mention you have to wait 1hr for 5 spins. Jeez !

I will say this is not a bad game. In fact, it's very good at its intended purpose (making money) given its position at #2 grossing, only behind the infamous candy inspired match 3 game. It's pretty standard for free games to have microtransactions, but this is a game that survives on the backs of whales. It's actually kind of hilarious how much of a rip off the store items are, and how little time you can actually "play" the game. 5 spins every hour, thousands of spins to progress the game.

Basically just a boring (and rigged) slots machine game. Absolutely nothing(!) else to do... No ads in game that's nice but you get bombarded by annoying pop-ups to remind you of the million ways to give them money, and constant push notifications that had to be blocked after just a few hours. Oh and I'll say it again : rigged! Don't be fooled into purchasing anything, it's a scam and they don't care about players, only money.

I wouldn't have played this "game" if I had not been paid to do so. There is no gameplay. Just build four buildings then move to the next "village" and repeat, indefinitely. How to advance is pure gambling. The main mechanic is a slot machine, the secondary is a lootbox, and the third is a daily roulette wheel. That is it. Oh, and the lootboxes are absurdly rigged, and every other mechanic is unbalanced or broken in some way.

Good for burning time. This simple game combines slots, card collecting, & village building with the occassional attack or raid. Gave it only 3 stars because certain things (like pet snacks) are extremely hard to come by unless you want to spend real world cash. EDIT: I've upgraded my review to 4 stars brcause you can now get a free petfood 1/day instead of having to pay for it.

The game is definitely fixed. The rewards bar is the worst gimmick of the game. You can have over 20k spins, only need 15k to reach the next spin pack, use all your spins just to be 3k short. It's no longer fun because it's pay to play. Make a small purchase and you can have "good luck" for about 2 hours. Don't make any and you end up being stuck on the same village due to lack of spins and coins. Consider Uninstaller or not downloading at all if you aren't going to spend money.

The game is fun. You get to spin, build your village up, attack others, etc. The real downside to this game are the card collections. It is almost impossible for you to get any GOLD cards to complete collections. Very few players will trade cards away out of kindness. They usually want cards in return. Developers need to change the rate at which gold cards drop, thus giving the players a better chance at completing sets.

Started off a great game. Now you can't get anywhere. Not even gold card. Lost 5,500 in bar rewards. Coin Master will not respond. When you spend money on the game you expect to get your rewards. Adding to my review. Still no response on my rewards. Now the game is continuously freezing up and taking my rewards. I now can not buy chest and I'm not getting them when I level up or make a purchase. It just freezes the game. NOT GETTING BETTER IT'S GETTING WORSE.

The game substantially changed in January 2025. It is nothing but a money grab. I had exceeded all levels but the puzzles became impossible. It was a daily game for me but after the changes, I uninstalled the game. I messaged support to cancel my account and they make it so difficult with many steps that I gave up. It was fun for many years but I absolutely do not recommend this game. I've uninstalled the game, moved on, and don't miss it at all.

I used to love this game so much. Then the price of my village pieces skyrocketed and I've had to waste billions (literally) of coins to build villages. I'm now on level 115 and have friends that are 20 to 30 levels higher than me that are paying a fraction of what I see to build my village. I've sent emails to support and they say that my village prices are normal and "as they should be" when that clearly is not the case. I've put a lot of time and effort into this game and now I want to quit!!

Fun game, love to play with my friends. But the in game pop ups are absolutely out of hand, there's at least five when you open the app and at least that many any time you run out of spins. The ratio of new to old cards when you buy chests is bonkers. I once spent 10 billion coins on chests and got TWO new cards. Today I bought a bunch of chests and got 8 cards in them, but the app said it was a cards boom, where were my extra cards?? There are a lot of things that need to be fixed on this app.

I would say 2/5 because it's a fun game, but I wouldn't recommend it. The game is only fun when you have 50 spins on the wheel, so you can gain money, build your village, raid, steal, etc. When you have 0 spins the game is useless, you're stuck at several coins and you cant buy anything, and you have to wait 30 minutes to get 5 spins. Those 5 spins don't work out, so you wait 24 hours. Boring :/

Was really enjoying the game. Was in a group and having fun. Even paid money to do extra things. THEN I went over the charges and saw double or triple charges for the 1 purchase. I did not spend over $250 in less than a week on this game but they sure charged me at least that. Working with Google play to get all my money back and this game away from me.

Really fun game, had been playing it for quite a while. Accidently made a large purchase of coins (the cost, not the amount of coins) and they would not void or refund as per their policy. My mistake, however they seem to stick to the letter of the policy, not make decisions on an individual situation. I have 4x as many coins sitting in the account right now, which would make this easy to reverse. However, they won't. Be very careful. Will not be playing any moon active games again.

I've been having problems with, not getting my rewards, as well as the game kept PAUSING on me. I've contacted support on numerous occasions, with no response for a week!!! And when they did respond, it was some excuse, telling me they would look into it. I've spent a lot of money on this game, just to have it rob me. Well, tonight 11/29/2021...I think I know why I have been having missing rewards, spins and all of supports lies as they will look into it. My phone alerted me, the app. CRASHED!

This game has become so bad. It does everything in its power to make you spend money. Twice today, I have spent well over 80000 spins, not left the game trying to get to the end of the 10 stage reward rapids. Each time on the 10th stage, it throws every time wasting tactic, and I end up crashing out literally a few hundred points before the final goal. Absolute Bollocks. I've played for a long time, but it's lost all the fun.

Ode to the things I play to get the things I want. I only downloaded this game so I get currency for an app that I use. While this game literally takes like 3 minutes to play, it's hilarious how greedy they are when it comes to wanting you to spend money. They force their advertisements after you run of out spins or when you run out of coin and it is ANNOYING! I'm not that invested but DAMN!! The game is not that serious!

Was decent to play. But lately a lot of issues. Today so far it's been over 2 hours and I can't enter the game, keeps saying connection lost check your connection to internet. My internet isn't the problem it's the app. Meanwhile I'm getting alerts saying my village is attacked. Just another way for coinmaster to take your money. Think I'm down with this game. Was a fun game to pass the time.

I deleted it because it kept telling me I had to buy this and that. It was fun the 1st 5 levels but then became bothersome with the interruptions. I actually had to play the game because of Ellen DeGeneres. What a Fake!!! Do 25 tasks and MAYBE you might get some cash. Now all I'm getting is phone calls for Insurance and Medicare!! This I do not need. Don't believe her, it's a trick.

I thought I was crazy until I looked at the other reviews. The game started out like any other game until... I attempted to play it like any other game.now I'm certain that the game has more glitches than it does benefits. As a game tester, this game is very upsetting. It took more time to to write this, approximately two and a half minutes then the time that I got to spend playing the game, total time of 45 seconds. Not because I didn't want to but because it glitched up and froze. Thank you.

Without doubt the worst mobile 'game' I have seen. The whole concept is pointless. The primary mechanic is a slot machine, and you use coins from it to pick things (which serve no purpose) to upgrade. The number of spins you have is very limited, but you can buy more. I feel sorry for anyone who pays for spins. Go donate that money to a charity or something, you'll get more of a dopamine rush. You could probably train a fish to play this game, and doing so would be more fun.

This game is the definition of a cash trap. You're barely able to get anywhere without sinking cash into it. And the more you give, the more predatory they get, forcing more packs, more bundles, more offers on you every single day. The current event's scoring system is all kinds of nonsensical, awarding points at COMPLETE RANDOM, and the higher you get in the game, the more gold they expect you to spend on village buildings WITHOUT INCREASING THE SCALE OF HOW MUCH CASH YOU GET to make it fair.

Fun game at first, but then the constantly having to click on the x of al the sales items just to continue gets on your nerves. You can play for free, but not for long. They just want money at every turn, or for you to invite your friends to share in the frustration. Tired of it already. I have played every single day for the last month and I am only on day four of a streak, so there is an issue with that also.

It's addicting, but I'm honestly debating quitting because of the constant pop-ups for in-game purchases and because the game will force you to steal coins from friends and teammates. What's the point in having a team if you're working against each other? EDIT: The pop-ups got WORSE. So, I deleted the game. It's honestly not worth a download unless you want to spend 5 minutes clicking off all the offers that the game throws at you every time you log in or run out of spins.

Really fun game. Love the different things to do. Very entertaining. Unfortunately I will changing my rating. So these testing company's hook up with the gaming developers and advertise you are paid a substantial amount to play the game so long. In my case it was 60 minutes and I was making progress on similar site to get to level three. Not only can I not get passed level three without paying but because the game won't let me go any further I can't play for the full 60. I'm taken 3 stars.

Just started working on the 3rd village, can't remember the name of it, off the top of my head.! 🤯 BUT; so far so good!!! @ this exact moment, I have to give 4-5! Now I may change my review as my play progress'.... There's so many different types of things that change as you progress to each level. So, my opinion & etc could be totally different, just varies from the proformance of the app it's self &:other factors. Other than that, this game is pretty much simple and easy to understand & play.

It was a very fun game for a long time, until I stopped getting my rewards & tournament prizes, even after writing to the support team I was still told I won't be receiving my prizes. I would spend money to pay the game and advance. But after this issue I will no longer spend my money nor do I enjoy playing as much. Best wishes to y'all just make sure you watch your spins & rewards. If you don't receive the right amount notify them so maybe they will do something about it. Thanks! Hope you enjoy

Well, I wasn't going to leave a review about how upsetting this game is, but after spending lots of money on this game and having as many technical issues as it does I am. I have been trying to go through support but was basically told, "Sorry you spent so much money and then lost your Joker card because of technical issues, there is nothing we will do to rectify your problem". I decided to go ahead and try playing again, however after less than 5 minutes, the game froze again and I lost it all.

You ruined the game!!!! This game would have gotten five stars from me if it were not for the recent changes!!!! Let's start with the fact that you took the pet snacks out of the weekly treasure chest. Then you take out the betting at 30 spins per spin option. And changed it to 15 then 50. If you take a look at my account you will see Ive spent A LOT of money on this game...NO MORE!!!!!! At least not until you fix the MISTAKES that you have made!!!!!

Cannot even play the game. I have been getting errors for several days and cannot even log in. It is the same error over and over. I have been receiving a connection lost error. I get it regardless of using wifi or data! I am so sick of blanket responses telling me it is being worked on. Yesterday they even claimed they sent me a gift and fixed it. Too bad I had to send ANOTHER screenshot showing them it is far from fixed and their gifts are useless since I cannot even play!

I have been playing this game for years and am part of a great Team. Although I still enjoy the game, as you progress, the cost to build your village is ridiculous especially for the very low payout once a village is complete. Would be nice to see the village payout increase as I am now rarely completing a village due to the unbelievable cost associated. Just not worth it anymore. (Very odd and out of touch generic response to my review!)

This use to be my favorite game but I feel like I get so ripped off whenever I spend $ in the game. For example I'll buy a chest that says you can win 75-7500 spins and I'll only win 100. It happens ALL the time. I feel like the further I get in the game the more stuff like this happens. To get to advance and play as much as I'd like I would have to spend seriously like $30 a day....otherwise you just are stuck in same spot forever. I'm actually debating uninstalling the game as of late.

Great game that keeps you attentive and it doesn't harm anyone. But on your bonus wheel you are to put free spins too because spins add up more than the money we receive and it would give people more time to play. And give more spend every hour if you want people to stick with the game and play it without spending a lot of money. I don't mind watching ads but I don't want to spend a lot of money to play the game. Give us more chances to have spins and more spend so we can play. That's just my op

I would have given this 5 stars until playing more recently. Loved it and play daily. Its gotten so difficult to progress you are forced to buy chests or spins. I never spend money on games but have been on this because I enjoyed it. But my items aren't always credited. Today, I worked to get tokens to buy Thor spins and spent a lot of money to buy the token storm because it usually has a lot of great chests and other items making it worth it.. NOT THIS TIME. It changed and I got 9K spins!!

Fun game but blatantly hinders your progress/keeps you from winning too much if you don't spend money on in-app purchases.. Edit: the problem I mentioned originally was fixed almost immediately after posting my review and it seems to be much more consistent and "fair" with or without in-app purchasing (air quotes around "fair" because, as everyone should already know, the house always wins lol). Only reason still 4 stars is the pop-ups, takes so long to start playing because of them.

I'm changing my review from five to four stars. I love this game, it's really the only one I'm playing right now, HOWEVER the amount of in game pop ups is too much. Every time you log on there's at least four you need to x out. Evey time you run out of spins it's the same. Honestly it's super annoying and makes me not want to play some days.

Stupid game. I downloaded and played to get an in-game currency for another game (which was denied). You spin a slot machine to get coins and you use those coins to build a small village? And well that's it. You get cards for pets or something but I didn't play it long enough to understand that. One of the biggest issues for me is that there are WAY TOO MANY POP-UPS. You load up the game, and you have to exit about 10 pop-ups to actually play. That's what ultimately made me uninstall.

This game is so entertaining and addicting. It's the type of entertainment that I just can't help spending a few dollars on. My friends would tell me why I spending money on a game that doesn't make U money? But one by one I got them to sign up and now they all are playing every night! Some of them are in my clan and we're progressing in levels quickly. I highly recommend this game!😀 Couldn't give it 5 stars due to the glitches on my iphone 11. Unable to message my teammates. Maybe update me.

Get ready for exciting bombardments of prompts to join via Facebook at least four times every time you launch the game! Prepare to be thrilled by constant popups asking if you want to purchase coin bundles! Seriously, one of the worst games i have played. Simplistic gameplay, pay to win, and highly annoying. If you have money to blow, there are better games put there.

Okay.. This game is officailly a joke. 500M coins cost $99.00 when it takes 10B coins or more to build a village depending on the level. Oh lets not get started on how much those Spins can cost you! This is not cool. The further you get in this game, the harder it is and requires you to have to spend money to actually at least try and pass some levels. Their little bundle packs give you more then their coin packages or spin packages. But even those can get ridiculous on pricing some times.

I'm catching on finally! This game is nothing more than a cash grab. 7 pop ups on opening the game. 7 pop ups when I run out of spins. "Goals" set purposefully so you run out of things when there's a new event starting. For example: prices for upgrading the village drop right before a "coin type event" happens so you won't have enough coins to even play. Many more complaints but Google limits u to 500 characters. Going to finally uninstall 👎👎👎👎

I have been playing this game for a while and have had a few bad experience. First of I was playing the game before work one morning and it was time to leave. I had around 1,200 spins when I left for work. I took lunch about 5 hours later and the spins were gone. That's one of many misshapes with the game. Here the past few days the game want load and now I've lost my bonus for playing conservative days. Could you please explain what is going on with the game. Thanks

I do like the game VERY MUCH! It's fun & a great way to pass the time. What I DON'T LIKE is the fact that no matter how much I play & no matter how many chests I buy (with real $ & coins from the game) getting new cards to complete my sets is ABSOLUTELY IMPOSSIBLE!!!!!! I have surpassed SEVERAL levels & still can't get the cards that I need. You have to hope for the chance that you get a Joker to fill in what you need. Due to this I can only rate the game with 1 star.

This is a terrific game I love playing it in mmt down time. I only have a couple complaints. 1, I just bought about 100 of the purple chests and didn't get a new card please do something about the spawning of new cards. 2, having to continually buy chests one at a time gets boring after a while. Could we please get the option to buy in bulk? Like five chests at a time?

I recently encountered a problem. I logged my FB account in the game before and it works fine but now, my friends can't attack me and also can't send me cards, spins, and coins. I can still send them cards, but once they search for me in their own accounts, I am not included in their friends list. I've tried reinstalling, logging off and on again, and clearing cache. Please help me with this.

Game is fun. Rewards for tournaments are not worth the time and resources. Be prepared to spend countless hours and resources trying to get cards to finish sets. A tool to get multiple chests and open multiple chests at once, would be a great addition. Like most of these games, they are here to make money. If you are looking for a game to play every day without spending, this isn't it.

I feel a tad generous having given this game a rating of 3 only because of a new game with a similar layout I came across but with far more depth to the game and play time. Prior to that game I'd have given this game a 4. The game is easy to play and has creative art work and characters but it seems unless you spend the money and have 'friends' on Facebook to help with spins, you run out of coins so quickly. I log in and I'm done spinning in 5mins. Age of Coins is so much better to me.

Waste of time and money! By the time you're at level 50 and above it's all about money. In the early levels spins are cheaper but higher up it's the same amount for much bigger money! And the card collections can never be filled because you never get the new gold cards despite buying hundreds of chests! And they hold competitions on facebook that never have winners. Even on the game's facebook page there are many people complaining of the same issues over and over! Don't waste your time!

I love this game! There are a couple of things that bother me .... I have to add someone on Facebook in order to trade cards (I am a private person) ... then there's the fact that we only get 5 spins per hour which makes it difficult to get chests, coins, and cards ... lastly, the events won't load for me half the time so I miss out on stuff.

I like this game. But I'm so sick of getting the same cards in the chests that you have to buy with coins and not being able to do anything with them! I have over 100 of several of the same cards! You should at least be able to trade them in for coins, spins, or chests. And you should be able to send any gold card to friends. Not just the occasional ones that they let you trade! And spins should accumulate faster and well. You have to spend actual cash to really get anywhere in this game.

I did enjoy Coin Master until about a month ago. I have been stuck on the level for about a month. To complete set all I am waiting for is gold cards and they never pop up in the chests. Waiting an hour just to get 5 spins is absolutely ridiculous and I refuse to spend any of my money on a game. It is asinine. It would be a much more enjoyable game if gold cards would pop up once in awhile. Even the rares.

I still have not received thousands of coins & spins that "disappeared" during play from back in Oct 2019. I reported this & all they did was give me suggestions on how to get them back. I did everything they suggested to no avail. Recently I stopped receiving my daily email reward. Texted problem & thought issue was resolved. Next day the same problem. I did everything they suggested to no avail. Finally, I just signed up again for daily email rewards. So far I haven't received today's email.

Reached level 150 and I have to call it quits. Beginning was fun, but the more I play....seems that the game is stacked against you in order not to finish a task without spending money. Just had over a few thousand of spins and needing only a couple hundred items to hit... If I was in Vegas... I would have caused a scene and cursing how the machine is rigged. Well buyer beware... there's a reason why this game generates so much money. I'm done!!! Btw, pop ups galore...keeps interrupting game.

This game is BEGGING you to send an invite to others, watch adds and to spend money. Ran out of spins? Here are 5 pop-up adds! Oh, you're in the MIDDLE of spinning? QUICK! BUY OUR COINS! What's that? You want to go offline? Here, let's get 7 AI's to attack you. It pretends like anyone is dumb enough to play but it's 100% singleplayer. This game is addicting and not in a good way. Begging to invite people and to buy more spins. The ultimate "get on for a minute and leave", multiple times a day.

Surprisingly addictive. However I'm now adding an update. You can tell when they are trying to get you close enough to where you have to purchase something to go on or to achieve a goal. Then I just spent $6.99 on a package that was supposed to have six free items. The screen flashed away and all of a sudden I got two and the rest I need you to pay $8.99 for. Very shady and extremely untrustworthy.

Game is fun despite irritations mentioned in other reviews: pop ups for in-app purchases, events that seem unlikely for one to win. The one that broke the camel's hump was that all my progress got cut down without notice. I want to say I got to at least village 170+ but today, game put me at 122 and I didn't notice it until I realized it's one I already done. Mega frustrating considering the lack of rhyme or reason for that!

Game it's very basic. So you don't need to be a gamer by any means. If your looking for something to spend s bit of time this is good. Buy from this game's point of view, not much annoys me more then asked to buy this or that for what feels like a minute. Not the kind of game for me so don't expect a 5 start from me even if this game was optimised to me. Graphics. Control, are good.

Rather simple game. Push the button, get resources from a slot machine to upgrade your village so you can move to the next identical (except for the art) slot machine. Attack random villages to gain resources to upgrade your village. Not bad, but nothing to keep you coming back (unless you're using this game to game resources in another game).

The game is addictive, BUT as the levels progress, costs for items become very high. You are given ample opportunity to buy items in the game. While buying these options can speed your way through levels, but once you start paying for help in the game , it can become hard to stop! Essentially this a gambling game that takes your money, with NO chance of making any money back. I should installed the game via an offer from Lucky Day app, with the promise of 3M tokens. NOTHING HAPPENED!!! RIPOFF!

I like this game but it said if I add a friend through Facebook I would get 110 free spins if they downloaded the game. They added the game and have been playing but I never received the spins nor are they on my friends list. Update: never got my free spins. I've put in so much real money to this game and no matter how much I put in, it's never enough. The game gets worse as time goes on. Unless you have unlimited money to put in, forget it! So frustrating!

Its fun when you have spins. Or coins. But whoever sets prices for things has to be crazy. I'm now on level 220ish, and if I want to buy a single magical chest, the equivalent value in coins is $60USD. This is despite the fact that your rewards dont really increase without spending significant money (which I have). And now the game is at the point where I cannot progress without spending comically large amounts of money. If you have the willpower to spend $0 on this game, its a 4/5. 1/5 for me.

I've been playing this game for 3+yrs now & I've never been disappointed like now. For some time now, us players, struggle to complete sets/villages. And you want to increase the prices on chests? We cant save our pet's food anymore? We cant get new cards like before? Villages prices higher again? You want us to be forced to use more real money to move forward?
